proof_body:
by
  intro ι _ s t x m₁ m₂ V₁ V₂ M W hs ht hd hm₁ hm₂ hV₁ hV₂ hM hW
  have key : ∀ (u : Finset ι) (m v : ℝ), u.Nonempty → m = (∑ i ∈ u, x i) / u.card → v = (∑ i ∈ u, (x i - m) ^ 2) / u.card → ∑ i ∈ u, x i ^ 2 = u.card * (v + m ^ 2) := by
    intro u m v hu hm hv
    have hn : (u.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hu)
    have hS : ∑ i ∈ u, x i = u.card * m := by
      rw [hm]
      field_simp
    have hc : ∀ i ∈ u, (x i - m) ^ 2 = x i ^ 2 - 2 * m * x i + m ^ 2 := fun i _ => by ring
    have h : ∑ i ∈ u, (x i - m) ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ u, x i ^ 2 - 2 * m * ∑ i ∈ u, x i + u.card * m ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hc, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hv, h, hS]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hn₁ : (0 : ℝ) < s.card := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have hn₂ : (0 : ℝ) < t.card := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr ht)
  have hN : (s.card : ℝ) + t.card ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hc : ((s ∪ t).card : ℝ) = s.card + t.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_union_eq_card_add_card.mpr hd]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have k₁ := key s m₁ V₁ hs hm₁ hV₁
  have k₂ := key t m₂ V₂ ht hm₂ hV₂
  have k₃ := key (s ∪ t) M W (hs.mono Finset.subset_union_left) hM hW
  rw [Finset.sum_union hd, k₁, k₂, hc] at k₃
  have hS₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = s.card * m₁ := by
    rw [hm₁, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hn₁.ne']
  have hS₂ : ∑ i ∈ t, x i = t.card * m₂ := by
    rw [hm₂, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hn₂.ne']
  have hM' : M = (s.card * m₁ + t.card * m₂) / (s.card + t.card) := by
    rw [hM, Finset.sum_union hd, hS₁, hS₂, hc]
  have hW' : W = (s.card * (V₁ + m₁ ^ 2) + t.card * (V₂ + m₂ ^ 2)) / (s.card + t.card) - M ^ 2 := by
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, eq_div_iff hN]
    linarith
  have alg : ∀ n k a₁ a₂ u v : ℝ, n + k ≠ 0 → (n * (a₁ + u ^ 2) + k * (a₂ + v ^ 2)) / (n + k) - ((n * u + k * v) / (n + k)) ^ 2 = (n * a₁ + k * a₂) / (n + k) + n * k * (u - v) ^ 2 / (n + k) ^ 2 := by
    intro n k a₁ a₂ u v h
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hW', hM']
  exact alg _ _ _ _ _ _ hN
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) [DecidableEq ι] (s t : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (m₁ m₂ V₁ V₂ M W : ℝ), s.Nonempty → t.Nonempty → Disjoint s t → m₁ = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → m₂ = (∑ i ∈ t, x i) / t.card → V₁ = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - m₁) ^ 2) / s.card → V₂ = (∑ i ∈ t, (x i - m₂) ^ 2) / t.card → M = (∑ i ∈ s ∪ t, x i) / (s ∪ t).card → W = (∑ i ∈ s ∪ t, (x i - M) ^ 2) / (s ∪ t).card → W = (s.card * V₁ + t.card * V₂) / (s.card + t.card) + s.card * t.card * (m₁ - m₂) ^ 2 / (s.card + t.card) ^ 2
